activity.notes: 8 November 1942 Casablanca/Morocco Operation Torch landing is an exact representative event for command of US Western Task Force, NOT a one-day force command or a duplicate national government. Its formation overlapped I Armored Corps command. Military operational organization is not a sovereign Polity.

sources.title: National WWII Museum — General George S. Patton
sources.citation_text: Museum historian documents Patton at Pershing Mexico 1916, leading 304th Tank Brigade 1918, WWII Western Task Force in North Africa starting 8 November 1942, Sicily Seventh Army 10 July 1943, operational Third Army beginning 1 August 1944, and later Bavarian military governorship after Nazi defeat.

sources.title: Library of Congress — George S. Patton (1885–1945): Timeline
sources.citation_text: Library of Congress chronology: 1916 Pershing's Punitive Expedition; 1918–1921 304th Tank Brigade; 1938–1940 Third Cavalry; 1940–1941 Second Armored Brigade; 1941–1942 Second Armored Division; 1942 I Armored Corps; 1942–1943 Western Task Force/II Corps; 1943 resuming I Armored Corps; 1943–1944 Seventh Army; 1944–1945 Third Army; 1945 Fifteenth Army.
